questions.question: The new robotic arm is capable of ______ complex surgical procedures with precision.
questions.explanation: be capable of 的 of 為介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞，故選 performing。

questions.question: Many people consider ______ important to set goals for their personal and professional lives.
questions.explanation: 句型為 S + consider + it + adj. + to VR，it 是虛受詞，真正的受詞是後面的不定詞片語 to set goals...。

questions.question: The mortgage rate at this bank is lower than ______ of the other bank.
questions.explanation: 比較對象是單數名詞 the mortgage rate，用指示代名詞 that 代替。代替複數名詞才用 those。

questions.question: AI tools can instantly carry out complex tasks, ______ enables people to work more efficiently.
questions.explanation: 逗號後的非限定用法關係代名詞只能用 which，此處 which 指前面整句。that 不能用於非限定用法，what 不引導形容詞子句，it 會造成兩句無連接詞的錯誤。

questions.question: The sensor in the plastic electronic arm would enable Alex ______ his hand by slightly flexing his biceps muscle.
questions.explanation: enable + O + to VR 意為「使……能夠……」，故選 to open。

questions.question: In the subtitle "Body Parts That Don't Cost an Arm and a Leg," what does the phrase mean?
options: The body parts are not very expensive.
The body parts cannot replace real arms and legs.
The body parts are made without plastic.
The body parts are only for children.
questions.answer: The body parts are not very expensive.
questions.explanation: cost an arm and a leg 意為「非常昂貴」，加上否定即「不貴」。這也呼應課文 artificial limbs can be produced relatively cheaply，同時與義肢主題形成雙關。

questions.question: According to the passage, why have many sea creatures suffered?
options: Because 3D-printed reefs attract too many fish.
Because the Caribbean project was launched too late.
Because coral reefs are too rough in texture.
Because of the decreasing number of coral reefs caused by rising sea temperatures.
questions.answer: Because of the decreasing number of coral reefs caused by rising sea temperatures.
questions.explanation: P3 指出全球暖化使海溫上升，海洋生物因此受害，尤其是因為珊瑚礁數量減少（especially due to the decreasing number of coral reefs）。

questions.question: Sea temperatures have risen ______ an alarming degree because of global warming.
questions.explanation: to a(n) + adj. + degree/extent 意為「到……的程度」，故選 to。

questions.question: To help protect sea creatures' habitats, a project ______ on 3D printing has been launched.
questions.explanation: 句中已有主要動詞 has been launched，此處需用分詞片語修飾 project。由 which relies on 省略關代並改為現在分詞 relying，表主動。

questions.question: According to the notes on the 3D-printed building, how long did it take workers to assemble the concrete pieces?
questions.explanation: 圖像筆記寫明 It took workers only 2 days to assemble these individual concrete pieces。17 天是 3D 印表機列印部件的時間，250 是建築面積（平方公尺）。
